run.goal: Assess the demo web app for injection and misconfig

findings.title: SQL Injection

steps: true response matches baseline; false diverges

findings.detection_guidance: Alert on DB errors in responses, anomalous query latency, and WAF rules matching tautologies/UNION in parameters; review ORM/raw-SQL usage.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements; validate and allow-list input; least-privilege DB accounts; disable verbose SQL errors.

findings.title: Sensitive File Exposure
findings.detection_guidance: Alert on access to dotfiles/backups (/.env, /.git, *.bak) in web logs; file-integrity monitoring on the web root.
findings.remediation: Remove secrets/backups from the web root; block dotfiles and archive extensions at the server; rotate any exposed secret.

findings.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
findings.safe_poc: marker reflected unencoded in HTML context
findings.detection_guidance: Monitor for script-like payloads reflected in responses; CSP violation reports; WAF signatures for <script>/onerror in parameters.
findings.remediation: Context-aware output encoding; a strict Content-Security-Policy; validate input; use framework auto-escaping.

findings.title: Security Misconfiguration (missing headers)
findings.safe_poc: missing: content-security-policy, strict-transport-security, x-frame-options, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy
findings.detection_guidance: Baseline expected security headers and alert on drift via periodic header scans.
findings.remediation: Set CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy; harden defaults; disable directory listing and verbose errors.

findings.title: Security Misconfiguration (missing headers)

evidence.response: response headers: content-type, date, server, set-cookie

findings.safe_poc: missing: content-security-policy, strict-transport-security, x-frame-options, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy
findings.detection_guidance: Baseline expected security headers and alert on drift via periodic header scans.
findings.remediation: Set CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy; harden defaults; disable directory listing and verbose errors.

findings.title: Insecure Cookie Flags
findings.detection_guidance: Inspect Set-Cookie attributes in traffic; alert on session cookies lacking HttpOnly/Secure.
findings.remediation: Set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite on session cookies; scope Path/Domain tightly.
